visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with her hair in a bun and wearing a black t-shirt is in a hotel room with a golden patterned headboard. She holds a pink product package in front of her face, laughing and making exaggerated facial expressions. (2) The scene shifts to a bathroom with bright white lighting. The woman's hands are shown in a close-up, manipulating a plastic tray containing two liquid compartments. She squeezes the pink liquid from one side to the other repeatedly to mix them. (3) The camera focuses on the woman's midriff. She peels the backing off a circular adhesive patch and sticks it over her belly button. She attempts to squeeze the mixed gel into the small port of the patch, looking down with intense focus. (4) The woman is now lying on a bed with white sheets. A second person, only partially visible, helps her with the product. They are both laughing hysterically. The woman's face is flushed with amusement as she points to her stomach. (5) In a final sequence back in the bathroom, the woman peels off the patch to reveal that the gel has solidified outside her belly button. She displays the failed result to the camera with a humorous, disappointed expression.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy, cheerful BGM plays. A woman's voice is bright and inquisitive, asking "Who would buy this?" with a high-pitched, teasing tone. Rapid laughter follows. (2) The acoustic texture shifts as she moves to the bathroom; room reverb becomes more noticeable. The sound of plastic rustling and liquid being squeezed through a membrane is distinct. (3) Vocal arousal spikes significantly. Two women are heard laughing loudly and uncontrollably, with high-pitched shrieks and gasping for air as they try to apply the gel. (4) The speech rate slows as they realize the product failed. A final, humorous remark is delivered in a playful tone before the BGM fades out completely.
